beats.say: Canada is the second biggest country on Earth, but almost nobody lives in it.
beats.title: CANADA IS ALMOST EMPTY

beats.say: About two out of three Canadians live within one hundred kilometers of the US border.
That thin strip holds Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver, Ottawa and Calgary.
Canada has around forty one million people. California alone has almost forty.
So why hug the border? The north is frozen ground, tundra and rock. The south has the warmest climate, the best farmland and the trade.
Canada is huge on the map, and tiny where people actually live. Follow for more.
beats.title: HUGE MAP. TINY COUNTRY.
